From table to FPGA.

Simple modules for your Dijkstra project. Download everything in a single folder.

  • V
    vga_path_display.vNode status + ordered path
  • V
    vga_timing_640x480.v50 MHz clock, pixel enable
  • V

  • +
    Config, ROM, integration guideIncludes sample data and SDC clock

No .do scripts or vendor IP. Assign your board’s VGA pins in Quartus. For 16 nodes in original 12-bit mode, the VGA port names and widths are preserved.

Integration details

The display shows a node grid and a paged path strip. Node status comes from your Dijkstra core. The generated ROM is read on the 50 MHz clock; read data appears after the rising edge.

Above 16 nodes, the bundle widens node IDs, path packing and the visited mask. Your Dijkstra core must use the same widths. An extended display adds a path_page input.

The VGA pixel rate is 25 MHz (about 59.52 Hz), approximating 640 × 480 at 60 Hz. Monitor compatibility and board timing still need hardware verification.

NodeForge0-based nodes · Directed edges · Integer weights 0–255Built for the path ahead.

Your table. Your graph. Your ROM.

  1. Set 1–100 nodes and 1–100 neighbour slots. Press Apply.
  2. Enter each connection as destination (weight), for example 4 (12). Node IDs and weights in the table are decimal.
  3. Blank means unused. A reverse edge must be entered separately. Zero-weight edges, self loops and parallel edges are allowed.
  4. Paste tab-separated cells from Excel into any table cell. Export CSV to take the table back to Excel.
  5. Run Dijkstra, then inspect the ordered path, total weight and algorithm trace.
  6. Download graph.mem and place it in the simulator’s working directory or your Quartus project directory.
Original: 12-bit words, 0–15 node IDs, FFF unused. Extended: 16-bit words, 0–99 node IDs, FFFF unused. Extended files need wider Dijkstra hardware.

The supplied graph.mem is the sample’s source of truth. Unused FFF slots are kept blank, including where the screenshot shows self-edges of weight 63.

Edits stay in this open page. Download your table or ROM before closing it.
